text:
tori: Quick doc PR incoming: small troubleshooting note for Private installer covering SELinux filecontexts, cgroup v2 hint, and a Podman rootless caveat. Tagging @raj for systemd snippet and @sasha for SDK/examples.

raj: I can add a minimal systemd drop-in recommending a dedicated user `redwoodsvc`, Slice and LimitNOFILE.

sasha: For airgapped installs include manual mkdir/chown/chmod and a `restorecon`. Warn against disabling SELinux; suggest `setenforce 0` only for temporary debug.

eng-platform: Add a one-line Podman note: rootless containers may place sockets under different uid/gid; suggest `--userns=keep-id` or explicit tmpfs mount for /var/run/redwood.

secops-bot: Security checklist: restrict PKCS#11 socket directory to group `redwoodsvc`, avoid symlinks, include distro package names for semanage fallback.

docs-bot: CI queued for branch tori/kms-selinux-note.

tori: Draft snippet I'll push: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.socket.d/10-selinux.conf
[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/redwood/kms.sock
Service=redwood-kms.service
``` ```bash
# airgap manual fix
sudo mkdir -p /var/run/redwood
sudo chown redwoodsvc:redwoodsvc /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
sudo chmod 0660 /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
# RHEL: semanage + restorecon (if available)
sudo semanage fcontext -a -t container_var_run_t '/var/run/redwood(/.*)?' || echo "install policycoreutils if missing"
sudo restorecon -R /var/run/redwood
```

raj: LGTM. Keep the airgap steps to a short bullet list in the doc.

sasha: I'll review SDK examples to ensure socket path docs match.

tori: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4338 — will merge after secops sign-off. Thanks!
